analysis.executiveSummary: The proposed trade sends elite 24-year-old RB De'Von Achane to Corgi Loaf Baking Co. in exchange for D'Andre Swift, Wan'Dale Robinson, and a 2027 1st-round pick (projected mid-range). While the raw numeric AVI sum of the incoming package appears higher, this deal violates core package realism principles by trading an S-tier cornerstone for secondary depth pieces ('3 dimes for a dollar'). Crucially, for a team committed to winning the championship, downgrading from Achane (97.4 C-AVI) to Swift (76.7 C-AVI) at starting RB2 significantly lowers weekly lineup points and damages championship odds.

officialAviAnalysis.sideAChampionshipImpact: De'Von Achane is a premier fantasy engine (97.4 C-AVI, 292.0 projected PPR points). Moving him deprives Conquistadors of an elite starting RB2 alongside Bijan Robinson, severely weakening weekly championship projection.
officialAviAnalysis.sideADynastyImpact: Achane is a 24-year-old cornerstone RB (96.8 D-AVI) locked into a multi-year high-volume role on a top NFL offense following his lucrative extension.
officialAviAnalysis.sideARosterImpact: Losing Achane leaves Conquistadors with extremely thin RB depth behind Bijan Robinson, forcing Tyjae Spears (50.4 C-AVI) or Keaton Mitchell into prominent roles if Swift suffers any dropoff.
officialAviAnalysis.sideBChampionshipImpact: D'Andre Swift (76.7 C-AVI) provides respectable RB2 production, Wan'Dale Robinson (65.7 C-AVI) adds high-floor WR depth, and the 2027 1st adds zero current points toward the 2026 title.
officialAviAnalysis.sideBDynastyImpact: Swift (86.1 D-AVI, age 27) and Robinson (83.6 D-AVI, age 25) are dependable starter/flex assets, while the 2027 1st (79.3 D-AVI) offers solid long-term draft capital.
officialAviAnalysis.sideBRosterImpact: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. acquires an elite cornerstone RB1, consolidating roster depth into a high-end starter without sacrificing their WR core.
officialAviAnalysis.valueAssessment: Summed AVI (221.7 for Side B vs 97.4 for Side A) is misleading. Elite cornerstones require near-peer quality in return. Exchanging a 24-year-old S-tier RB for an aging RB2, a bench WR, and a future mid 1st dilutes starting lineup advantage.

publicMarketAnalysis.summary: Public consensus views Achane as an explosive elite RB1 who recently signed a 4-year, $64M extension and is fully healthy for camp. Swift is valued as a solid RB2 entering year two in Chicago's Ben Johnson offense, while Wan'Dale Robinson's stock has risen after signing a $70M deal with Tennessee to be Cam Ward's top underneath target.
publicMarketAnalysis.aviVsMarket: AVI's high rating of Achane matches the market's high-ceiling consensus. Swift and Robinson are valued appropriately as high-floor, limited-ceiling starters.
relevantContext: De'Von Achane signed a 4-year, $64M extension in May 2026 and has been fully cleared for training camp.
D'Andre Swift coming off a 1,000-yard season as the lead back in Chicago.
Wan'Dale Robinson reunited with offensive coordinator Brian Daboll in Tennessee as a heavy target sponge.

frontOfficeAnalysis.opposingGmMotivation: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. would be highly motivated to make this trade, as it allows them to package depth and a future pick to acquire a elite S-tier RB to pair with Justin Jefferson and Malik Nabers.
frontOfficeAnalysis.packageFit: From Corgi Loaf's perspective, this deal fits a contender consolidating assets. For Conquistadors, the fit is poor because it weakens an already thin RB room.
frontOfficeAnalysis.lineupReplacement: Swift replaces Achane in the starting lineup but creates a steep drop of 20.7 C-AVI points and 70.3 projected PPR points at RB2.
frontOfficeAnalysis.competitiveWindowFit: Conquistadors are actively in 'Win Championship' mode. Trading away a 24-year-old elite starter for future pick capital directly conflicts with this competitive window.
frontOfficeAnalysis.positionalScarcity: Young S-tier running backs with elite per-touch explosive capability and secured contract volume are among the rarest assets in fantasy football.

marketReality.explanation: While Corgi Loaf Baking Co. would eagerly accept Achane for depth and a pick, this transaction fails crucial validations for Conquistadors. It trades a premier 24-year-old cornerstone for secondary depth and future capital, harming the user's primary goal to win the championship.

verdict.rationale: Conquistadors should decline this deal. Trading away an elite 24-year-old S-tier RB in De'Von Achane (97.4 C-AVI) for D'Andre Swift, Wan'Dale Robinson, and a 2027 1st violates package realism by diluting cornerstone quality into secondary assets. More importantly, as a contender focused on winning the championship, lowering your starting RB2 projection by over 20 C-AVI points directly weakens your starting lineup.
